symptom: Belt stops intermittently The belt stops intermittently during operation.
failure_mode: Photo-eye sensor blocked by dust The photo-eye sensor is blocked by dust on the lens or reflector.
corrective_action: Clean the photo-eye lens and reflector Clean the photo-eye optics and confirm the sensor LED is green. Clean the photo-eye lens, remove dust from the reflector, and confirm that the sensor LED is green.
corrective_action_name: Clean the photo-eye lens and reflector

symptom: Belt stops intermittently The belt stops intermittently during operation.
failure_mode: Belt tension below specification Belt tension is below the specified deflection range.
corrective_action: Adjust the belt tensioner to 8 mm to 12 mm deflection Adjust the belt tensioner until deflection is within specification. Adjust the belt tensioner until belt deflection is between 8 mm and 12 mm.
corrective_action_name: Adjust the belt tensioner to 8 mm to 12 mm deflection
